Query::count: Refresh, accessor, size; invalid receiver prints and answers 0; evaluation itself is the query system's

free Count(player, class): reads the owner's class tally (0x004441e0/0x00444030 on [record+0x8c]), now HeroSystem::class_tally: add 0x00447200 (class + ancestors, from register 0x0041f310 and Mutate), take 0x004448a0 (stops at first missing name, unclamped, on the present owner, from 0x0041eee0: death, erase, SetNoselectFlag); Unit::SetPlayer (0x005dc3f0) moves it -- unregister on the old owner, register on the new when posRH >= 0 (fixed round 14: class-tally.md said a change of owner moved nothing; test set_player_moves_a_unit_from_the_tally_it_leaves_to_the_one_it_joins); garrison and ships do not move it; docs/formats/class-tally.md; tests count_reads_the_class_tally_..., the_class_tally_drifts_..., the_class_tally_is_saved_and_hashed. FIXED round 14: every birth registers at the moment the original does (SpawnGroup/InHolder/Named, make_mule, ShowBuildAnimation; the manager's start drains the pending list; Place's squad filing waits for the next turn, labelled), and the latch [0x00a8734c] is the map editor's, never up in a game. Gaps: the move hook (0x0041f530) is a once-a-turn sweep; player <= 0 reads out of the record table in the original, answers 0 here

GAIKA::Count/6: Eval/6's walk counting heads -- the node deque in order, category 0x0044e250 off the viewer row (negative viewer = all own), presence 0x0044e1f0 with 0x0044eb80 for enemies, accumulator 0x00427e90 (messenger squads skipped, enemy_hidden), member count [squad+0x50], settlement tail 0x00420c00 adding the wall's head count [+0xf4] for a BaseTownhall with strength > 0; no memory tail (fixed: census_of had none of the viewer, sight, messenger, hidden or wall rules; test gaika_eval_adds_the_settlement_skips_messengers_and_sees_as_the_ai_sees, census test)

GAIKA::Count/3: node deque in order, strength, relation 0x0044e250 off the viewer row (player<1 = all own) against sides, presence 0x0044e1f0(,,1) & staying with 0x0044eb80 for enemies (fixed: absent), members by descent (0x00427fc0); tail 0x00420c00: BaseTownhall heir with strength [+0xf8] > 0 and head count != 0, category in sides, class under Sentry adds [+0xf4] (fixed: gated on head count alone; test gaika_count_by_class_walks_the_staying_squads_and_then_the_settlement)

ItemHolder::count: answers vtbl+0x104 of the holder subobject (the object plus the handle's adjustment), or 0 with the 'uninitialized or invalid object' message. Slot 0x104 is the holder's item count: ItemHolder::HasItem, RemoveItem and RemoveAll (0x0053c6c0, 0x0053c910, 0x0053cb20) bound their walks by it, beside 0xf4 (the item at an index) and 0xf0 (remove); the concrete override was not resolved. No shipped site reaches it, and m_count refuses an ItemHolder receiver
Squad::Count: is-a by name over the squad's members; comma-list acceptance labelled (no shipped site)
ClearDead: unresolvable or vtbl+0x50 (IsDead) members erased in place; same rule as m_is_dead

SquadList::Add: FIXED -- plain append, no dedup (0x00437870 -> 0x00435d90); test squadlist_add_goes_through_the_objlist_domain

Obj::Clear: writes the invalid handle through a by-reference receiver; prose corrected from "writes into the object"

RemoveList: one first-occurrence erase per member of the argument (scan 0x0050e2a0, erase 0x0041ecc0), front to back; RemoveList(self): the walk by absolute position always lands on the present front, which is found and popped (offset up, end fixed), so the list empties; past the last erase the deque resets its offset to 0 and the walk idles to its 32-bit wrap (a stall with no state, not reproduced); test objlist_remove_and_removelist_take_one_occurrence_per_handle

GetUnitsOnBoard: a copy (not an alias) of the ship holder's deque [holder+0x30], holder = ship+1; FIXED (spatial-index round): the order is the holder's roster, the order the units came aboard (World::contents_of: each member's stamp of joining, written by put_in_holder, saved), where it was ascending id; test objlist_get_units_on_board_lists_the_passengers_in_the_order_they_came_aboard
NearestObj (point): 10,000,000 start, strict less, edge distance 0x005a7900
